Individual persecution.requires: evidence of targeting of the person
Individual persecution.provides: a Convention ground engaged, dependence on personal credibility

Generalised violence.requires: an armed conflict in the country of origin
Generalised violence.provides: a complementary protection route, no need to show individual targeting

Economic hardship alone.provides: no Convention ground at all, refusal on the merits

Statelessness.provides: a distinct legal status, no country obliged to receive a return

Testimony only.provides: dependence on consistency and plausibility, no corroboration available

Medico-legal report.provides: physical findings consistent with the account, expert weight

Country information contradicting the cl.provides: a strong basis to refuse, great difficulty for the claimant

Full substantive interview.provides: a detailed account tested, months of processing

Accelerated border procedure.provides: a decision within days, little opportunity to gather evidence

Safe third country transfer.provides: no examination of the merits at all, removal to that state

Appeal before a tribunal.requires: a refusal and a right of appeal

Refugee status granted.provides: leave to remain, family reunion rights

Humanitarian protection granted.requires: serious harm but no Convention ground
Humanitarian protection granted.provides: leave to remain, fewer ancillary rights

Claim refused and removal ordered.provides: return to the country of origin, appeal rights exhausted

Claim withdrawn or abandoned.requires: a claimant disappearing from the process
Claim withdrawn or abandoned.provides: no decision made at all, the file closed

CLAIM BASIS|DECISION OUTCOME.requires: return to the country of origin
CLAIM BASIS|DECISION OUTCOME.blocked_by: no country obliged to receive a return

PROCEDURE|DECISION OUTCOME.blocked_by: no examination of the merits at all
